plugin.name: Herdr
plugin.description: Use herdr, the terminal workspace manager for coding agents, from Termix with touch, mouse and a native navigator.

tab.title: Herdr
tab.needsTerminal: Herdr needs the SSH Terminal plugin
tab.needsTerminalHint: Turn on SSH Terminal in Plugins. Herdr runs inside its terminal so your host's login, keys and host key checks work as usual.
tab.badSettings: This host's herdr settings are not valid
tab.badSettingsHint: Edit the host and check the herdr path and session name under Herdr.

chrome.sortToggleHint: Switch between priority order and grouped by space
chrome.resizeSidebar: Drag to resize sidebar (double-click to reset)
chrome.resizeSplit: Drag to resize Spaces and Agents split (double-click to reset)
chrome.resizeNavigator: Drag to resize inspector (double-click to reset)
chrome.jumpNeedsYou: Jump to next agent waiting for input

keys.prefixHint: Send herdr's prefix key, then type the action key
keys.modifiedKey: Key to send with the modifier

actions.gotoHint: Open herdr's go to picker (prefix, g)
actions.sidebarHint: Show or hide herdr's sidebar (prefix, b)

navigator.emptyOutput: No output in this pane yet.
navigator.blockedHint: This agent is waiting for interactive approval. Tap a key below or use Run.

confirm.workspaceGroupClose: Close workspace {{name}} and all linked worktree workspaces?
confirm.description: Programs running in it are stopped.

use.title: Use Herdr
use.description: Open herdr on hosts the user can connect to, and control its workspaces, panes and agents.

enable.label: Herdr
enable.description: Offer the Herdr view for this host.

runtimeMode.label: Herdr runtime
runtimeMode.description: Choose whether this host uses the new herdr-core (hc) + herdr-app runtime or the legacy herdr 0.9.x TUI.

binaryPath.label: herdr / hc command
binaryPath.description: The hc, herdr-core or herdr binary on the host. A name on PATH or a full path; ~/ is your home folder.

sessionName.label: Session
sessionName.description: A named herdr or HC_SESSION session to use. Leave empty for the default session.

sidebarLayout.label: Herdr sidebar
sidebarLayout.description: How the herdr-app Spaces and Agents left sidebar opens on desktop.

agentSort.label: Agent list grouping
agentSort.description: How agents are grouped in the Herdr sidebar.
agentSort.priority: By priority (Needs you, Done, Working, Idle)

touchMouse.label: Touch as mouse
touchMouse.description: Turn taps, long presses, drags and swipes into mouse clicks, right clicks, drags and scrolling for herdr.

longPressMs.label: Long press time (ms)
longPressMs.description: How long to hold before a touch becomes a right click, or the start of a drag.

prefixKey.label: herdr prefix key
prefixKey.description: Match the prefix in your herdr config.toml. The Prefix button and the picker buttons send it.

showKeyBar.label: Key bar
showKeyBar.description: Show a bar with Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, arrows and herdr actions under the terminal.

agentNotifications.label: Agent notifications
agentNotifications.description: Show a toast when an agent needs your input or finishes a task.
